# <span id="aanchor323"></span> Close Approval

Use the Location Close Approval screen to evaluate the performance and efficiency of a location, acknowledge PPAs and exceptions, view the open members of a location, and close the location manually.

It displays energy and volume data for the current month in addition to the past five months. You can select a location that requires manual close approval and view various totals with volume and energy data viewed in either standard or measured mode.

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Closing a Location Manually">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Closing a Location Manually</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Closing a Location Manually">

<div class="procedure">

To access the Close Approval screen:

1.  Go to **Setup** \> **Location** \> **Close Approval**.

2.  Select the desired location from the drop-down menu.

3.  Click the **Approve** button. The location will be marked as closed.

    The Approve button will only be available if all of the requirements have been satisfied. If any of the location members are still open, the Approve button will be disabled and the Open Items button will be visible. Click this button to view a list of location members that are still open. If PPAs have been applied to any location members, the **Approve** button will be disabled until the **PPAs Outstanding** option is enabled. If any monthly values exceed the validation limits, the **Approve** button will remain disabled until a comment has been entered.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 561;height: 400;" />

Upon closing a location:

- The name of the person who closed the location, and the date and time of the close are recorded in the database and display in the Close Approval screen.
- The Status field will auto update to show that the location has been closed.
- A **Show Revisions** button becomes visible once the selected month for the selected location has been closed. (See: [Location Close Revisions](Location%20Close%20Revisions.md))

</div>

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Requirements to Close a Location">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Requirements to Close a Location</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Requirements to Close a Location">

Locations created with Requires Approval to Close enabled are placed in the Location Rollup Queue. After the location rolls up, the Location Close Data Service writes an exception stating that this location requires approval to close. For a location to be closed manually, four conditions must be met:

- The location must be rolled up.
- All location members (meter and location) must be closed first.
- Any PPAs rolled up from members must be acknowledged by setting a checkbox.
- A comment must be made if any values are outside of the validation limits.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 543;height: 393;" />

<div class="procedure">

To create a location that requires approval to close:

1.  Go to **Setup** \> **Location** \> **Editor**.
2.  Click **New** and enter a location name and number.
3.  Set the location type to "Balance."
4.  Go to **Tools** \> **Info** and check the **Requires Approval to Close** checkbox.
5.  Click **OK**.
6.  Add meter and/or location members.
7.  Click the **Save** button.

</div>

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Data Columns">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Data Columns</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Data Columns">

The data columns will adjust depending on which Values radio button is selected (Gas or Liquid).

Gas

- If you select "Gas" for a non-inventory location, the values will be displayed as gain/loss and percent difference of volume and energy.
- If you select "Gas" for an inventory location, the values will be displayed as total inventory for volume and energy.

Liquid

- If you select "Liquid" for a non-inventory location, the values will be displayed as gain/loss and percent difference of sum of component volume and mass.
- If you select "Liquid" for an inventory location, the values will be displayed as total inventory of sum of component volume and mass.

</div>
